name: ac-doc-coauthoring
description: Staged co-authoring workflow for structured documents (proposals, specs, decision docs, RFCs): the author and the agent build the document together through explicit stages including context gathering, iterative section-by-section construction, and a fresh-reader test before release. Use when asking 'co-author this document', 'draft this proposal with me', 'let's write this spec together', 'guide me through writing this RFC', 'test my draft with a fresh reader', 'PRD', 'decision doc'. Not for producing a first draft alone (ac-drafting), line-editing an existing draft (ac-editing), or doc-type conventions (ac-spec-writing).
